provenance: Synthetic prompts, 2026-09-26: generated per group by an offload LLM that never saw the router, relabelled by an independent model (gemini); only items where both labels agree are kept. Hard negatives (tool-ish words, no tool needed) are marked. The eval fixtures (ChatEvalFixtures) are NOT in here: they are the router's test set. The 'activity' group was regenerated the same day (44 items, same two-model agreement) after the fixture test showed the first batch was mostly reminders, not look-backs at the user's history with the assistant: a class-level gap found by the test set, disclosed here. Conversational class added 2026-10-17 (#622): mid-conversation turns (follow-ups on what the assistant just said, thanks and reactions, personal news) labelled none, and look-backs at a previous day's session labelled activity, so the gate learns the in-chat/past-session line. Generated by gemini-3.5-flash-lite, labelled cold by claude-haiku-5.5; only agreements kept (70 of 89, one held-out near-copy removed); the address word "Mike" is stripped from them, since every generated look-back carried it and the gate would learn the name instead of the phrasing, marked conversational. The voice-rig lines that exposed the gap are held out (near-copies removed). Only the gate (ToolNeedRouterWeights) was regenerated from this set: the group head's retrain lowered its floor and dispatched in-chat look-backs, so ToolGroupRouterWeights stays on the 393-item set until the router chateval arm runs. Offer class added 2026-11-02: offer-shaped lines, the sentence M1K3 ends a reply on ("Want a short story about it?", "Shall I check the forecast?"). On a content-free yes ("yes please", "go on") the gate reads M1K3's offer instead of the user's words, so it has to tell an offer to write, explain or keep talking (none) from an offer to look something up or act (a tool). The shipped gate read creative offers as tools. 360 lines were generated by one model and labelled cold by a second; only lines where both agreed with high confidence were kept, marked offer. Creative offers are none and hard; lookups take web, knowledge or device. Action offers (reminder, timer, to-do and calendar writes, opening a site, one to-do read) have no group of their own and are labelled script, the acting class the group head never dispatches. Every line was checked against the held-out text (the voice-rig lines, the ChatEvalFixtures prompts, the blind follow-up sets' offer replies, and the gate's offer pins) with the search trainer's token-Jaccard near-copy rule: 57 of 353 were dropped, leaving 296 (156 none, 70 web, 23 knowledge, 18 device, 29 script). The same rule removed 12 older lines that near-copy held-out text (4 device, 7 none, 1 web), so the set went from 463 to 747 items. Only the gate was regenerated: the group head (ToolGroupRouterWeights) was NOT retrained and stays as committed, per the #631 rule, until the router chateval arm runs on a new one.
